newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes soft on seasonal demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes soft on seasonal demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar softened slightly to 471.00/472.00 bolivars per dollar on seasonal corporate demand for dollars ahead of Christmas, traders said, but that demand is proving weaker than in previous years.
"Many businesses have already stocked-up, so import demand is down when compared to other years," said one trader.
Nevertheless, the bolivar softened as the Central Bank abstained from intervening. The market was "dry of dollars", said one trader.
The unit closed at 470.00/471.00 on Friday.
